name: Guest suite
description: Imports and displays Guest Suite customer reviews via the Guest Suite REST API, with a review entity and rating tokens.
project_description:
Provides Guest Suite API integration for Drupal. 

 Features 
 
 
 Dedicated Guest suite review entity 
 
 Available fields: 
 
 Remote ID 
 Guestapp ID 
 Status 
 Created 
 Changed 
 User name 
 Title 
 Comment 
 Creation date 
 Publication date 
 Experience date 
 Type 
 Global rate 
 Establishment ID 
 Establishment ID guestapp 
 Authenticity url 
 Unique token 
 Warning URL 
 
 
 
 
 Manual/automatic Guest Suite API request 
 
 Import all reviews or the last ones from API with CRON, or manually in the entity collection view. 
 
 
 
 Establishment block 
 
 Display all informations about one selected establishment.
